## Scope

This report summarizes the current Step 2 pipeline outputs generated from:

- `data/Zika_News_2015.csv`
- Pipeline code in `src/classification/`
- Final output `data/processed/articles_classified.csv`

```{python}
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

import pandas as pd
import yaml

pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 200)
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth", 120)


def find_repo_root(start: Path) -> Path:
    for p in [start, *start.parents]:
        if (p / "data").exists() and (p / "src").exists():
            return p
    raise RuntimeError("Could not locate repository root from current working directory.")


ROOT = find_repo_root(Path.cwd())
PROC = ROOT / "data" / "processed"
LOGS = ROOT / "data" / "logs"
RAW = ROOT / "data" / "raw_html"

CFG_PATH = ROOT / "src" / "classification" / "config.yaml"
INPUT_PATH = ROOT / "data" / "Zika_News_2015.csv"
UNIQUE_PATH = PROC / "zika_2015_unique.csv"
FETCH_PATH = PROC / "fetch_results.csv"
EXTRACT_PATH = PROC / "articles_extracted.parquet"
CLASSIFIED_PATH = PROC / "articles_classified.csv"
URL_REGISTRY_DB = ROOT / "data" / "url_registry.sqlite"
LOG_PATH = LOGS / "classification_pipeline.log"

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src" / "classification"))
from utils import canonicalize_url, detect_schema, is_google_news_wrapper_url
from IPython.display import display


input_df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_PATH, low_memory=False)
unique_df = pd.read_csv(UNIQUE_PATH, low_memory=False) if UNIQUE_PATH.exists() else pd.DataFrame()
fetch_df = pd.read_csv(FETCH_PATH, low_memory=False) if FETCH_PATH.exists() else pd.DataFrame()
extracted_df = pd.read_parquet(EXTRACT_PATH) if EXTRACT_PATH.exists() else pd.DataFrame()
classified_df = pd.read_csv(CLASSIFIED_PATH, low_memory=False) if CLASSIFIED_PATH.exists() else pd.DataFrame()

with open(CFG_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    cfg = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}
```

## Artifacts

```{python}
rows = []
for label, path in [
    ("Input RSS CSV", INPUT_PATH),
    ("Deduplicated URLs", UNIQUE_PATH),
    ("Fetch Results", FETCH_PATH),
    ("Extracted Articles", EXTRACT_PATH),
    ("Classified Articles", CLASSIFIED_PATH),
    ("URL Registry (SQLite)", URL_REGISTRY_DB),
    ("Pipeline Log", LOG_PATH),
]:
    exists = path.exists()
    size_mb = (path.stat().st_size / (1024 * 1024)) if exists else None
    mtime = datetime.fromtimestamp(path.stat().st_mtime).isoformat(timespec="seconds") if exists else None
    rows.append(
        {
            "artifact": label,
            "path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "exists": exists,
            "size_mb": round(size_mb, 3) if size_mb is not None else None,
            "last_modified": mtime,
        }
    )

pd.DataFrame(rows)
```

## 2) URL Resolution + De-duplication

```{python}
url_col = schema.get("url_col")
tmp = input_df.copy()
tmp["_canonical_raw"] = tmp[url_col].map(canonicalize_url) if url_col else None

valid_raw_urls = int(tmp["_canonical_raw"].notna().sum()) if url_col else 0
unique_raw_canonical = int(tmp["_canonical_raw"].nunique(dropna=True)) if url_col else 0
raw_duplicates_removed = int(valid_raw_urls - unique_raw_canonical)
google_wrapper_rows = int(tmp[url_col].astype(str).apply(is_google_news_wrapper_url).sum()) if url_col else 0

resolved_rows = 0
resolver_failures = 0
if not unique_df.empty:
    if "resolved_url" in unique_df.columns:
        resolved_rows = int(unique_df["resolved_url"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().ne("").sum())
    elif "url_resolution_method" in unique_df.columns:
        resolved_rows = int(
            unique_df["url_resolution_method"].fillna("").astype(str).str.contains("google_decode|resolved", case=False).sum()
        )

    if "url_resolution_error" in unique_df.columns:
        resolver_failures = int(unique_df["url_resolution_error"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().ne("").sum())
    elif "url_resolution_method" in unique_df.columns:
        resolver_failures = int(
            unique_df["url_resolution_method"].isin(["google_decode_failed", "resolver_exception"]).sum()
        )

pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {"metric": "input_rows", "value": len(input_df)},
        {"metric": "rows_with_valid_raw_canonical", "value": valid_raw_urls},
        {"metric": "unique_raw_canonical_urls", "value": unique_raw_canonical},
        {"metric": "raw_duplicates_removed", "value": raw_duplicates_removed},
        {"metric": "google_wrapper_rows_in_input", "value": google_wrapper_rows},
        {"metric": "resolved_google_wrapper_rows", "value": resolved_rows},
        {"metric": "resolver_failures", "value": resolver_failures},
        {"metric": "output_rows_in_zika_2015_unique.csv", "value": len(unique_df)},
    ]
)
```

if not classified_df.empty:

```{python}
if not classified_df.empty:
    model_aliases = sorted({c[: -len("_model_id")] for c in classified_df.columns if c.endswith("_model_id")})
    rows = []
    for alias in model_aliases:
        rel_col = f"{alias}_relevant"
        conf_col = f"{alias}_confidence"
        err_col = f"{alias}_error"
        model_id_col = f"{alias}_model_id"

        rel_true = int((classified_df[rel_col] == True).sum()) if rel_col in classified_df.columns else 0
        rel_false = int((classified_df[rel_col] == False).sum()) if rel_col in classified_df.columns else 0
        errors = int(classified_df[err_col].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().ne("").sum()) if err_col in classified_df.columns else 0
        avg_conf = float(pd.to_numeric(classified_df[conf_col], errors="coerce").mean()) if conf_col in classified_df.columns else float("nan")
        model_id = classified_df[model_id_col].dropna().iloc[0] if model_id_col in classified_df.columns and not classified_df[model_id_col].dropna().empty else ""

        rows.append(
            {
                "alias": alias,
                "model_id": model_id,
                "relevant_true": rel_true,
                "relevant_false": rel_false,
                "avg_confidence": round(avg_conf, 4) if pd.notna(avg_conf) else None,
                "error_rows": errors,
            }
        )

    display(pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("alias"))
else:
    display(pd.DataFrame({"note": ["No per-model output available."]}))
```

## 5) Pipeline Log Diagnostics

```{python}
log_re = re.compile(r"^(?P<ts>\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2} \\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}),(?P<ms>\\d{3}) \\| (?P<level>[A-Z]+) \\| (?P<msg>.*)$")


def parse_runs(log_path: Path):
    if not log_path.exists():
        return []
    runs = []
    cur = None
    for raw in log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines():
        m = log_re.match(raw)
        if not m:
            continue
        ts = datetime.strptime(m.group("ts"), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        msg = m.group("msg")
        level = m.group("level")

        if "Pipeline started" in msg:
            cur = {"start": ts, "end": None, "warnings": 0, "classification_progress_events": 0, "cache_stats": ""}
            continue
        if cur is None:
            continue

        if level == "WARNING":
            cur["warnings"] += 1
        if "Classification progress:" in msg:
            cur["classification_progress_events"] += 1
        if "Classification cache stats:" in msg:
            cur["cache_stats"] = msg
        if "Pipeline completed successfully" in msg:
            cur["end"] = ts
            runs.append(cur)
            cur = None
    return runs


runs = parse_runs(LOG_PATH)
if runs:
    last = runs[-1]
    duration_s = (last["end"] - last["start"]).total_seconds() if last["end"] else None
    pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "latest_run_start": last["start"].isoformat(sep=" "),
                "latest_run_end": last["end"].isoformat(sep=" ") if last["end"] else "",
                "duration_seconds": duration_s,
                "warning_events": last["warnings"],
                "classification_progress_events": last["classification_progress_events"],
                "cache_stats": last["cache_stats"],
            }
        ]
    )
else:
    pd.DataFrame({"note": ["No complete runs parsed from log."]})
```

## 6) Interpretation

```{python}
if not extracted_df.empty and not classified_df.empty:
    uniq_titles = int(extracted_df["extracted_title"].nunique(dropna=False))
    uniq_texts = int(extracted_df["extracted_text"].nunique(dropna=False))
    interstitial_blocked_rows = int((extracted_df["extraction_method"] == "interstitial_blocked").sum())
    final_counts = classified_df["final_label"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict()

    print(f"- Extracted title cardinality: {uniq_titles}")
    print(f"- Extracted text cardinality: {uniq_texts}")
    print(f"- Interstitial-blocked rows: {interstitial_blocked_rows}")
    print(f"- Final label distribution: {final_counts}")
else:
    print("- Could not compute interpretation due to missing extracted/classified outputs.")
```

## Reproducibility

Run pipeline from repository root:

```bash
python src/classification/run_pipeline.py \
  --input data/Zika_News_2015.csv \
  --outdir data/processed \
  --config src/classification/config.yaml
```

Render report:

```bash
quarto render src/classification/classification_report.qmd
```
